senses.en: not showing a serious or respectful attitude, in a situation that deserves seriousness

example.en: His flippant remarks annoyed everyone at the meeting.
example.zh: 他轻率的言论让会上所有人感到恼火。

senses.en: an electrical component that resists the flow of electric current

example.en: The circuit needs a resistor to limit the current.
example.zh: 这个电路需要一个电阻器来限制电流。

senses.en: not fertilized, especially not having been joined with a male cell

example.en: Hens lay unfertilized eggs routinely.
example.zh: 母鸡会经常产下未受精的蛋。

senses.en: a metal tool used for turning nuts and bolts (British term for wrench)

example.en: He used a spanner to tighten the bolt.
example.zh: 他用扳手拧紧了螺栓。

senses.en: pieces of cloth hung at windows or around a stage

example.en: She drew the curtains to let in the light.
example.zh: 她拉开窗帘让光线进来。

senses.en: (informal, usually plural) the end or death of something

example.en: If the deal fails, it could be curtains for the company.
example.zh: 如果交易失败，公司可能就完蛋了。

senses.en: a strong polyester fabric used in clothing and sails

example.en: The shirt is made of cotton and dacron.
example.zh: 这件衬衫由棉和涤纶制成。

senses.en: relating to Asia or its peoples and cultures

example.en: She enjoys cooking many Asian dishes at home.
example.zh: 她喜欢在家做很多亚洲菜。

senses.en: a person from Asia

example.en: Many Asians live and work in this city.
example.zh: 许多亚洲人在这个城市生活和工作。

senses.en: a person who thinks seriously about ideas

example.en: Confucius is regarded as one of the greatest thinkers in history.
example.zh: 孔子被公认为历史上最伟大的思想家之一。

senses.en: books, pictures or films made to sexually arouse people

example.en: Many countries have laws restricting access to pornography.
example.zh: 许多国家都有限制接触色情作品的法律。

senses.en: drunk or caused by being drunk

example.en: He was arrested for drunken driving last night.
example.zh: 他昨晚因酒后驾驶被逮捕。

senses.en: strong, powerful, and effective

example.en: She made a forceful argument in the debate.
example.zh: 她在辩论中提出了有力的论据。

senses.en: A large system of stars, gas, and dust held together by gravity.

example.en: Our solar system is in the Milky Way galaxy.
example.zh: 我们的太阳系位于银河系中。

senses.en: A group of famous or impressive people or things.
senses.zh: 一群显赫人物或出色事物

example.en: The event brought together a galaxy of talent.
example.zh: 这场活动汇聚了一批杰出人才。

senses.en: an organization that helps people in need, often funded by donations

example.en: She donates to a local charity every month.
example.zh: 她每月向当地一家慈善机构捐款。

senses.en: money, food, or help given to people in need

example.en: He gave most of his prize money to charity.
example.zh: 他把大部分奖金捐给了慈善事业。

senses.en: kindness and understanding toward other people

example.en: She showed charity toward her critics.
example.zh: 她对批评她的人表现出宽厚。

senses.en: a place in the ground where a dead person is buried

example.en: Flowers were placed on the grave.
example.zh: 人们在墓前摆放了鲜花。

senses.en: very serious; solemn or worrying

example.en: The report raised grave concerns about safety.
example.zh: 这份报告引发了对安全的严重担忧。

senses.en: the system of fundamental laws and principles of a country or organization

example.en: The constitution guarantees freedom of speech.
example.zh: 宪法保障言论自由。

senses.en: a person's physical health and strength

example.en: She has a strong constitution and rarely gets sick.
example.zh: 她体质很好，很少生病。

senses.en: the composition or structure of something

example.en: Scientists studied the constitution of the soil.
example.zh: 科学家研究了土壤的成分。

senses.en: an explosive device designed to detonate under specific conditions

example.en: The police cleared the area after finding a bomb.
example.zh: 警方发现炸弹后清空了该区域。

senses.en: to attack a place or target with bombs

example.en: Aircraft bombed the bridge at dawn.
example.zh: 飞机在黎明时轰炸了那座桥。

senses.en: to fail badly or be unsuccessful

example.en: The new play bombed with critics.
example.zh: 这部新剧在评论界惨败。

senses.en: a man from England

example.en: He is an Englishman who grew up in London.
example.zh: 他是一个在伦敦长大的英格兰人。

senses.en: in terms of money or finances

example.en: After the new job, she is financially stable.
example.zh: 换了新工作后，她的经济状况稳定了。

senses.en: damage or weakness in body or mind

example.en: Hearing impairment affects many older adults.
example.zh: 听力损伤影响许多老年人。

senses.en: a reduction in value or quality

example.en: The company recorded an impairment on the asset.
example.zh: 公司对该资产进行了减值记录。

senses.en: to give lessons or instruction in a subject or skill

example.en: She teaches math at a high school.
example.zh: 她在一所高中教数学。

collocations: teach someone how to do something

senses.en: to help someone learn by showing how; to show or explain

example.en: My parents taught me to be honest.
example.zh: 我的父母教导我要诚实。

senses.en: to work as a teacher

example.en: He taught for thirty years before retiring.
example.zh: 他任教三十年后退休了。

senses.en: the time that is yet to come

example.en: She is planning to study abroad in the future.
example.zh: 她计划将来出国留学。

senses.en: the likelihood of success or progress for something

example.en: This company has a promising future.
example.zh: 这家公司前景光明。

senses.en: relating to time after the present; happening later

example.en: Please bring your questions to our future meetings.
example.zh: 请在以后的会议上提出你的问题。

senses.en: to break up and move soil with a tool or hands

example.en: They dug a hole in the garden to plant a tree.
example.zh: 他们在花园里挖了个坑种树。

senses.en: to search for buried remains by digging carefully

example.en: Archaeologists dug at the ancient site for two months.
example.zh: 考古学家在那个古遗址发掘了两个月。

senses.en: a hurtful or mocking remark aimed at someone

example.en: Her comment about my cooking was a dig.
example.zh: 她对我厨艺的评论是句挖苦话。

senses.en: an archaeological excavation site

example.en: The students visited an archaeological dig in the valley.
example.zh: 学生们参观了山谷里的一处考古发掘现场。

senses.en: the act of combining separate parts into one whole

example.en: The integration of the two companies was completed last year.
example.zh: 两家公司的整合已于去年完成。

senses.en: the process of a group becoming part of a larger community or society

example.en: Social integration helps new immigrants feel welcome.
example.zh: 社会融合有助于新移民感到受欢迎。

senses.en: in mathematics, the process of finding an integral

example.en: Students learn integration in their first calculus course.
example.zh: 学生在第一门微积分课程中学习积分。

senses.en: the state of being taught or guided by someone

example.en: She improved rapidly under his tutelage.
example.zh: 在他的指导下，她进步很快。

senses.en: feeling upset because you have been treated unfairly

example.en: He felt aggrieved by the unfair decision.
example.zh: 他对不公正的决定感到愤愤不平。

senses.en: having had one's legal rights violated

example.en: The aggrieved party may file a complaint.
example.zh: 受侵害一方可以提出申诉。

senses.en: a stone or concrete structure built out into water to protect a shore or harbor

example.en: Fishing boats moored beside the jetty.
example.zh: 渔船停靠在防波堤旁。

senses.en: lasting only for a short time

example.en: The pain was transitory and soon faded.
example.zh: 疼痛是短暂的，很快就消退了。

senses.en: not supported by evidence or proof

example.en: The report was based on unsubstantiated claims.
example.zh: 该报道基于未经证实的说法。

senses.en: hard, boring, monotonous work
senses.zh: 苦差事；单调乏味的工作

example.en: Washing dishes every day feels like endless drudgery.
example.zh: 每天洗碗感觉像无休止的苦差事。

senses.en: a loose dress worn in bed, especially by women and girls

example.en: She put on her flannel nightgown before going to bed.
example.zh: 她睡前穿上了法兰绒睡裙。

senses.en: feeling grateful to someone for their help

example.en: I am deeply indebted to my teachers for their guidance.
example.zh: 我深深感激老师们的指导。

senses.en: owing money (legal/formal use)

example.en: The company was heavily indebted to its lenders.
example.zh: 这家公司欠债权人巨额债务。

senses.en: a young tree

example.en: The volunteers planted saplings along the riverbank.
example.zh: 志愿者们在河岸边种下了树苗。

senses.en: completely clear and leaving no doubt

example.en: She gave an unequivocal answer to the question.
example.zh: 她对这个问题的回答十分明确。

senses.en: a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and helps digestion

example.en: The doctor said his liver was healthy.
example.zh: 医生说他肝脏健康。

senses.en: the liver of an animal eaten as food

example.en: She cooked onions with chicken livers.
example.zh: 她用洋葱炒鸡肝。

senses.en: strong, energetic, and full of force

example.en: She took a vigorous walk every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早晨进行快步健走。

senses.en: forceful and determined in action or support

example.en: The government launched a vigorous campaign against pollution.
example.zh: 政府发起了坚决的治理污染行动。

senses.en: a sudden event causing great damage, loss, or suffering

example.en: The earthquake was a catastrophe that destroyed thousands of homes.
example.zh: 这场地震是摧毁了数千座房屋的大灾难。

senses.en: a young flower before it opens, or a growth on a plant that develops into a leaf or flower

example.en: The roses have produced several new buds.
example.zh: 玫瑰长出了几个新花蕾。

senses.en: to produce buds, or to begin to grow and develop

example.en: The trees are budding earlier this spring.
example.zh: 今年春天树木发芽更早了。

senses.en: (informal, chiefly North American) a friendly term of address for a friend or companion
senses.zh: （口语，主要用于北美）老兄，朋友

example.en: Come on, bud, let's get going.
example.zh: 走吧，老兄，我们出发了。

senses.en: the process of settling or being deposited, e.g. of sediment or particles

example.en: The deposition of sand gradually changed the shape of the coastline.
example.zh: 沙子的沉积逐渐改变了海岸线的形状。

senses.en: a witness's recorded statement taken before a trial

example.en: The lawyer read from the witness's deposition during the trial.
example.zh: 律师在庭审中宣读了证人的证词记录。

senses.en: the removal of a ruler or official from power

example.en: The deposition of the king led to years of political unrest.
example.zh: 国王被废黜引发了多年的政治动荡。

senses.en: similarity in appearance or detail between people or things

example.en: There is a strong resemblance between the twin sisters.
example.zh: 这对孪生姐妹长得很像。

senses.en: physical energy and enthusiasm

example.en: She attacked the job with vigour.
example.zh: 她干劲十足地投入这份工作。

senses.en: force or intensity of action, growth or effect

example.en: The government pursued the reforms with vigour.
example.zh: 政府大力推行改革。

senses.en: inside a building

example.en: It's raining, so let's stay indoors.
example.zh: 下雨了，我们待在室内吧。

senses.en: a pleasant smell, especially of perfume

example.en: The scent of roses filled the garden.
example.zh: 玫瑰的香味弥漫在花园里。

senses.en: a smell left by an animal or person that can be followed

example.en: The dogs followed the fox's scent through the woods.
example.zh: 狗群追踪着狐狸的气味穿过树林。

senses.en: to notice something by smell; to sense or suspect

example.en: The reporters scented a big story.
example.zh: 记者们察觉到了重大新闻。

senses.en: easily broken or damaged

example.en: Be careful with that box—the glasses inside are fragile.
example.zh: 小心那个箱子——里面的玻璃杯易碎。

senses.en: weak and easily harmed, not strong or stable

example.en: The country's economy remains fragile after the crisis.
example.zh: 危机之后，该国经济依然脆弱。

senses.en: not enough for a need or purpose

example.en: The city's public transport is inadequate for its growing population.
example.zh: 这座城市的公共交通无法满足不断增长的人口需求。

senses.en: not good enough or capable of doing what is needed

example.en: I feel inadequate when I have to speak in public.
example.zh: 每当必须当众发言时，我都觉得自己能力不足。

senses.en: to collect information or things together and arrange them in one place

example.en: She compiled a list of useful websites for her students.
example.zh: 她为学生整理了一份有用的网站列表。

senses.en: to translate program code into machine code

example.en: The program failed to compile because of a syntax error.
example.zh: 由于语法错误，该程序编译失败。

senses.en: attractively thin and slender

example.en: She stayed slim by exercising regularly.
example.zh: 她经常锻炼，保持了苗条的身材。

senses.en: small in amount or likelihood

example.en: There is only a slim chance of rain tomorrow.
example.zh: 明天下雨的可能性很小。

senses.en: to lose weight or make something thinner

example.en: He slimmed down by eating healthier food.
example.zh: 他通过吃更健康的食物瘦了下来。

senses.en: an animal hunted and eaten by another animal

example.en: Lions hunt their prey at night.
example.zh: 狮子在夜间捕猎猎物。

senses.en: a person or thing that is attacked, exploited, or victimized

example.en: Scammers often target the elderly as easy prey.
example.zh: 骗子常把老年人当作容易下手的目标。

senses.en: to hunt and eat other animals, or to victimize someone (prey on/upon)

example.en: Owls prey on small rodents.
example.zh: 猫头鹰捕食小型啮齿动物。

senses.en: a large primate with no tail or a very short tail, such as a gorilla or chimpanzee

example.en: The chimpanzee is an ape, not a monkey.
example.zh: 黑猩猩是猿，不是猴。

senses.en: to imitate someone or something, often clumsily or uncritically

example.en: Stop aping your friends and be yourself.
example.zh: 别再模仿你的朋友了，做你自己。

senses.en: the state of being kept in a restricted space or place

example.en: He spent months in solitary confinement.
example.zh: 他被单独监禁了几个月。

senses.en: the time just before, during, and after giving birth (old-fashioned/medical use)

example.en: The doctor attended her during her confinement.
example.zh: 医生在她的分娩期间照护她。

senses.en: a social or religious rule against doing or mentioning something

example.en: The community has a taboo against discussing money.
example.zh: 这个社群有不谈金钱的禁忌。

senses.en: forbidden or not acceptable to talk about or do

example.en: Money was a taboo topic at the dinner table.
example.zh: 在餐桌上，钱是个忌讳的话题。

senses.en: a person who tends and herds cattle or other livestock

example.en: The herdsman led his cattle to fresh pasture.
example.zh: 牧人把牛群赶到新的草场。

senses.en: a large symphony orchestra

example.en: The philharmonic performed Beethoven's Ninth Symphony.
example.zh: 爱乐乐团演奏了贝多芬第九交响曲。

senses.en: relating to or fond of music, especially in a group's name

example.en: They attended a concert by the city philharmonic society.
example.zh: 他们参加了市爱乐协会的一场音乐会。

senses.en: an expression of sympathy for someone who is grieving

example.en: Please accept my sincere condolences on your loss.
example.zh: 请接受我对你失去亲人的诚挚慰问。

senses.en: to make secret information known to others

example.en: She refused to divulge the details of the agreement.
example.zh: 她拒绝透露协议的细节。

senses.en: making great demands; requiring careful attention and effort
senses.zh: 要求严格的；费心的；艰巨的

example.en: Surgery is an exacting profession.
example.zh: 外科是一份要求严苛的职业。

senses.en: to make someone or something seem unimportant or of little value

example.en: Don't belittle her efforts—she worked very hard.
example.zh: 不要贬低她的努力——她工作得非常辛苦。

senses.en: exercises designed to help people lose weight

example.en: She does slimnastics every morning to keep fit.
example.zh: 她每天早上做瘦身操来保持身材。
